rules.name: lal-trigger-confirm-01
rules.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, c.relname AS table_name, t.tgname AS trigger_name, t.tgenabled AS enabled, p.proname AS function_name FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relname IN ('deal_active_lots_table', 'valuation_date_table') ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, t.tgname

SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name, p.proname AS function_name FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE p.proname IN ('fn_sync_latest_active_lot', 'fn_latest_active_lot_on_valuation_date', 'fn_latest_active_lot_reconcile', 'fn_rebuild_latest_active_lot_trade') ORDER BY p.proname, n.nspname

SELECT l.id, l.run_at, l.business_unit, l.cutoff, l.missing, l.extra, l.different, l.repaired, l.caller FROM opera.latest_active_lot_reconcile_log l WHERE l.run_at >= now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY l.run_at DESC LIMIT 500
SELECT v.business_unit, v.value_date, v.settlement_date, v.created_timestamp, v.updated_timestamp FROM opera.valuation_date_table v ORDER BY v.business_unit

SELECT l.business_unit, max(v.value_date) AS valuation_date, count(*) AS cache_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE l.value_date > v.value_date) AS rows_after_valuation_date, max(l.value_date) AS newest_cache_value_date, max(l.updated_timestamp) AS newest_cache_update FROM opera.latest_active_lot l JOIN opera.valuation_date_table v ON v.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND v.business_unit = l.business_unit GROUP BY l.business_unit ORDER BY 4 DESC
